title: Peru Adventure
name: Peru Adventure
stays: Sacred Valley · Starlodge · Aguas Calientes · Cusco
p1: Seven days and six nights from the Sacred Valley to Machu Picchu and Cusco. Visit the Maras salt mines and Moray terraces, sleep in a transparent capsule on a cliff at Starlodge, then ride the scenic train through the Andes to Machu Picchu.
p2: Six nights of hotels, private transportation, an English-speaking guide, the train to and from Machu Picchu and the domestic flight from Lima to Cusco are included.
storyImg: Machu Picchu wrapped in morning mist
presText: On day three, choose a zipline or the Via Ferrata to reach your Starlodge capsule, with an open-air hot tub and dinner. The next morning you descend and ride the train to Aguas Calientes.
wideImg: The terraces and ruins of Machu Picchu
